name: The Relinked mark, as viewer: a bookmark the identity service moved onto another copy of its film by a provider-id match (Strong) shows 'Relinked, check position' on its card in the Bookmarks row of the copy's details page, with 'Looks right' in the card's menu (the My bookmarks section's row before 1.6.0 / 2.4.0); Looks right (the rename with the unchanged name) clears the mark, the name and the video stay. Run by bookmarks-rows-probe.mjs after it made the relink: viewer's bookmark named 'rows-probe Moved' on Same Id Remake (1999), the 1999 copy held out and scanned, put back and scanned.

steps.name: find the 2005 copy of Same Id Remake
steps.eval: (await ApiClient.getItems(ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), { IncludeItemTypes: 'Movie', Recursive: true, SearchTerm: 'Same Id Remake', Fields: 'Path' })).Items.filter(i => /Same Id Remake \(2005\)/.test(i.Path || '')).map(i => i.Id)[0]

steps.name: the relinked bookmark on it
steps.eval: ((list) => { const b = list.find(x => x.Name === 'rows-probe Moved'); return b && b.Relinked === true && !b.Detached ? b.Id : null; })(await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks', { itemId: __vars.copyId })))

steps.name: there is one
steps.message: no relinked bookmark named 'rows-probe Moved' on the 2005 copy; run bookmarks-rows-probe.mjs

steps.name: its card: the line 'Relinked, check position' under its time
the menu of the card
steps.script: const c = document.querySelector('#itemDetailPage:not(.hide) .jfbm-bookmark-card[data-jfbm-card="' + __vars.bookmarkId + '"]'); if (!c) throw new Error('no such card'); const more = c.querySelector('.cardOverlayButton-br button, button.cardOverlayButton-br'); if (more) { more.click(); } else { c.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('contextmenu', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); } return [...document.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-row-menu-item')].map((x) => x.lastElementChild.textContent + (x.disabled ? ' (disabled)' : ''));

steps.name: Looks right in it; still playable (Play from here first and enabled)
the badge's colour (the kit's warning colour) and tooltip
the warning colour and the tooltip
steps.assert: __vars.badge.title === 'This bookmark moved to another copy of the video. Check that its position is still right.' && __vars.badge.color !== getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('#itemDetailPage:not(.hide) .jfbm-bookmark-card[data-jfbm-card="' + __vars.bookmarkId + '"]').querySelector('.cardText-first')).color

steps.name: Looks right, from the card's menu
steps.script: const c = document.querySelector('#itemDetailPage:not(.hide) .jfbm-bookmark-card[data-jfbm-card="' + __vars.bookmarkId + '"]'); if (!c) throw new Error('no such card'); const more = c.querySelector('.cardOverlayButton-br button, button.cardOverlayButton-br'); if (more) { more.click(); } else { c.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('contextmenu', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); } const items = [...document.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-row-menu-item')]; const b = items.find((x) => x.lastElementChild.textContent === 'Looks right'); if (!b) throw new Error('no Looks right in the card menu: ' + items.map((x) => x.lastElementChild.textContent).join(', ')); if (b.disabled) throw new Error('Looks right is disabled'); b.click(); return true;

steps.name: the line is gone, the same title
the menu of the card, confirmed
